text:
cory: deploybot flagged a p95 regression on the new routing change in v4.2.0 canary (eu-central). autopilot suggested fallback but blocked by require-operator. Anyone take lead?

anu: looking. canary slice=6%, p95 +300ms on long-history generation. no 5xxs. affects generator path only.

ops-bot: snapshot: region=euc1 canary=6% p95_delta=+300ms error_rate=0.7% host_restarts=0

lin: two options: (A) immediate full rollback to v4.1.7 in eu region, (B) regional pin for Dedicated customers and partial rollback for hosted canary. Pinning takes coordination with sales/legal.

cory: we should minimize customer impact. proposal: revert hosted traffic to v4.1.7 for eu, keep Dedicated pinned to v4.1.7 for 24h, and block autopilot for 48h. Criteria to act: sustained p95 >200ms for 3m + operator handshake.

anu: i can be operator. command: `/deploy revert --to v4.1.7 --region eu-central --operator anu --reason "canary p95 regression" --operator-lock 48h`

lin: if we pin Dedicated, we must update release notes and send an advisory to sales & affected accounts. @customer-success can you prepare short customer advisory?

customer-success: will draft: "We restored the previous stable version in EU due to a latency regression observed in a canary slice. Dedicated customers in the region will remain on the stable release for 24h while we investigate. No data loss expected." will coordinate with sales for account-specific notes.

support: please add a one-liner for our support triage template so we can tag tickets: "EU generator latency - fallback to v4.1.7 in region; see REL-7402."

cory: operator handshake: @anu confirm you have authority and will execute? Also confirm you will pin Dedicated pools.

anu: confirm. executing in 10s. will run pin after revert.

deploybot: Revert request received. Validating prechecks...

deploybot: Prechecks OK - artifact v4.1.7 verified, no migrations. Initiating regional revert: demote canary -> restore v4.1.7 in eu-central. ETA ~4m.

deploybot: Revert complete in eu-central. active=v4.1.7 (eu-central), inactive=v4.2.0, canary=0% in region.

anu: now pinning Dedicated pools in eu-central to v4.1.7 for 24h and setting autopilot suppression for 48h. command: `/deploy pin --pool dedicated-eu --version v4.1.7 --duration 24h --suppress-autopilot 48h`

deploybot: Pin acknowledged. Dedicated pool dedicated-eu pinned to v4.1.7 for 24h. Autopilot suppression set for 48h.

lin: filed REL-7402 with initial notes + long-context repro. add release-note bullet: "Temporarily restored v4.1.7 in EU due to latency regression in v4.2.0 canary; Dedicated pools pinned for 24h."

customer-success: advisory sent to sales and queued for external publish pending legal review.

cory: post-rollback plan: lin & anu to own root-cause and test hotfix; ops to monitor eu region for 24h; customer-success to handle outbound comms. We'll keep autopilot suppressed until post-mortem complete. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
